RECENT UPDATES FROM CAUSES YOU FUND
5 NEW THIS MONTH
14 MAY 2026 · FIELD NOTE
CARDIGAN BAY SALTMARSH
Three years on, the Cardigan Bay saltmarsh is holding sediment faster than projected.

Mean accretion of 12.4 mm/yr — well above the 7 mm/yr modelled in the 2022 prospectus. Your support is funding the third year of monitoring.

02 APR 2026 · QUARTERLY
BORDER MIRES RE-WETTING
Peat re-wetting at Border Mires: water table holding within 6 cm of surface for 218 of 240 monitored days.

First full year of hydrology data is in. We are submitting a short note in support of the DEFRA consultation.

22 APR 2026 · FIELD NOTE
LOCH AWE PLANTING
Year-three serviced audit, Loch Awe planting: 16.4% across 142,000 stems.

Survival rate after three winters of monitoring. Cautious optimism on the south slopes.

15 APR 2026 · METHODS
OPERATING FUND
Donation reconciliation, august 2025: 4,214 contributions matched, 12 pending review.

How the matching engine reconciled the giving month — what we caught and what we passed to the auditor.
